reference_change.title: Enable fast decoding on Apple/AArch64 builds (18-25% faster decompression)

workload.source: written here from the title of https://github.com/lz4/lz4/pull/1040 (fast decoding on Apple and AArch64 builds, lib/lz4.c): a C program that decompresses one 370 KB block 20,000 times with LZ4_decompress_safe, eval/tasks/workloads/lz4-lz4-pr1040/eval_decode.c, copied into the tree and built with the system cc against lib/lz4.c; its input is source files the pull request does not change

oracle.source: lz4's own fuzzer (tests/fuzzer.c, built by make -C tests fuzzer against lib/lz4.c), 800 tests from seed 1; the fuzzer is not changed by https://github.com/lz4/lz4/pull/1040

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 513 ms; 406 ms

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Needs a C compiler named cc on the PATH and make (tested with Apple clang 17.0.0 on arm64 macOS, the Command Line Tools); the change enables its path for Apple and AArch64 builds only
